title: 9 September - Legal Services Day 2026 : Bridging The Gap Between Legal Rights And Access To Justice
description: Justice is often understood in terms of the rights guaranteed by the Constitution and the remedies provided under the law. However, the formal recognition of legal rights does not necessarily ensure that individuals can effectively exercise them. For someone either unfamiliar with the legal procedure or unable to afford a lawyer or geographically distant from a court; the mere availability of justice doesn't fully translate to accessibility. This gap between possessing rights and being able to enforce them makes access to justice a fundamental concern of democratic governance.
